parameters.excerpt: A new supported format is added to the format field of most instructions, as shown in <<tab:fpextfmth>>.

parameters.excerpt: If the D extension is present, FCVT.D.H or FCVT.H.D converts a half-precision floating-point number to a double-precision floating-point number, or vice-versa, respectively.
parameters.reasoning: The presence of the D extension is an implementation choice that affects the availability of certain conversion instructions.

parameters.excerpt: If the Q extension is present, the FCVT.Q.H and FCVT.H.Q instructions are additionally included.
parameters.reasoning: The presence of the Q extension is an implementation choice that determines the availability of additional conversion instructions.
